FROM python:3.14-slim

WORKDIR /app
COPY . ./

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && \
    pip check

CMD exec gunicorn main:app --threads=8 --timeout=0
